  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The 1% Chance",
      "goal": "Survive the Isekai induction by landing a logic-defying critical hit on the Tutorial Boss.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From a confused victim of a summoning accident to a system-flagged anomaly with a bounty.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "N/A",
        "to_next": "Artie enters the first starter town with a 'Red Name' status and a broken agility stat."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Glass Cannon Glitch",
          "intent": "Introduce Artie's arrival and the discovery of his broken 1 HP / Max Crit state.",
          "end_condition": "Artie confirms his stats are glitched and accepts the tutorial challenge.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie wakes up in the summoning circle and discovers his 1 HP / Max Crit status.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he is a glass cannon anomaly.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "introduces": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Summoning Circle",
              "location_end_label": "Summoning Circle",
              "location_start": "LOC_SUMMONING_CIRCLE",
              "location_end": "LOC_SUMMONING_CIRCLE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The white light of the summoning ritual fades into the dim blue of the chamber.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["white light", "dim blue", "stone floor", "ozone smell"],
              "transition_out_text": "He stands up, feeling a strange weightlessness in his limbs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["weightlessness", "stone floor", "blue light", "status window"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie tests his movement and accidentally dodges a lethal environmental hazard.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie learns that his speed is his only defense.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "location_start_label": "Summoning Circle",
              "location_end_label": "Training Hall",
              "location_start": "LOC_SUMMONING_CIRCLE",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_HALL",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A step forward sends Artie sliding across the floor like he's on ice.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sliding", "stone floor", "momentum", "blur"],
              "transition_out_text": "The System chime rings in his ears as a prompt appears.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["System chime", "digital prompt", "Training Hall", "iron gate"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie reviews the tutorial prompt and commits to the challenge despite the risk.",
              "type": "decision",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts the tutorial challenge.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "location_start_label": "Training Hall",
              "location_end_label": "Training Hall",
              "location_start": "LOC_TRAINING_HALL",
              "location_end": "LOC_TRAINING_HALL",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The floating text hovers before him, glowing with an insistent golden light.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["floating text", "golden light", "Tutorial Accept", "iron gate"],
              "transition_out_text": "With a mental click, he confirms the choice and the gate grinds open.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["mental click", "iron gate", "grinding stone", "dark corridor"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie confirms his stats are glitched and accepts the tutorial challenge."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "Tutorial Gauntlet",
          "intent": "Demonstrate the danger of the 1 HP build against minor mobs.",
          "end_condition": "Artie reaches the Boss Room threshold without taking damage.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie faces his first mob, a slime, and realizes he must never be touched.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie defeats the slime by kiting it at high speed.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Corridor",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Corridor",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_CORRIDOR",
              "location_end": "LOC_TUTORIAL_CORRIDOR",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "A wet squelch echoes through the corridor as a green mass slides into view.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["wet squelch", "green mass", "corridor", "torchlight"],
              "transition_out_text": "He leaves the puddle of slime behind, his heart racing at the speed of his own feet.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["slime puddle", "racing heart", "stone walls", "distant door"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie navigates a series of swinging blade traps using his maxed agility.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie reaches the Boss Room threshold without taking damage.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Corridor",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Room Threshold",
              "location_start": "LOC_TUTORIAL_CORRIDOR",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_THRESHOLD",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The air whistles as heavy steel blades begin to swing from the ceiling.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["whistling air", "steel blades", "ceiling", "rhythmic thud"],
              "transition_out_text": "He skids to a halt before the massive double doors of the final chamber.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["double doors", "final chamber", "heavy breathing", "threshold"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie reaches the Boss Room threshold without taking damage."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "The Impossible Crit",
          "intent": "The confrontation with the Tutorial Boss and the logic-defying kill.",
          "end_condition": "The Tutorial Boss dies in one hit and Artie is flagged as a Red Name anomaly.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie enters the Boss Chamber and identifies the Iron Golem's weakness.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie formulates a plan to land a single critical hit.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Room Threshold",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Chamber",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_THRESHOLD",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_CHAMBER",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The doors groan open, revealing a vast arena of cracked marble.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["doors groan", "vast arena", "cracked marble", "dust"],
              "transition_out_text": "The Golem stirs, its iron joints screeching as it locks onto the intruder.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["iron joints", "screeching", "intruder", "red eyes"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie engages the Golem, kiting it until his 1% crit chance procs.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie survives the Golem's initial onslaught through pure speed.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Chamber",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_CHAMBER",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_CHAMBER",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "The Golem's fist smashes the marble where Artie stood a millisecond before.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fist smash", "marble", "millisecond", "blur"],
              "transition_out_text": "He circles the giant, waiting for the one opening that the System promised.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["circling", "giant", "System promise", "opening"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie lands the critical hit, deleting the Golem and triggering a system alert.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "The Tutorial Boss dies in one hit and Artie is flagged as a Red Name anomaly.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_BOUNTY"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Chamber",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Chamber",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_CHAMBER",
              "location_end": "LOC_BOSS_CHAMBER",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "transition_in_text": "A flash of red numbers erupts as Artie's dagger finds the Golem's core.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["red numbers", "dagger", "Golem core", "explosion"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The Tutorial Boss dies in one hit and Artie is flagged as a Red Name anomaly."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "chapter_id": 2,
      "title": "Min-Maxing for Cowards",
      "goal": "Identify the 'Hit & Run' passive exploit and acquire the first piece of 'Agility-only' gear.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From an accidental killer to an aspiring exploiter looking to turn a glitch into a career.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arrival in Oakhaven with a red name and zero survival skills.",
        "to_next": "A quest for a 'Speedster's Cloak' leads Artie into a high-level dungeon far above his bracket."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Oakhaven Paranoia",
          "intent": "Artie navigates the first town while hiding his criminal status.",
          "end_condition": "Artie identifies the 'Hit & Run' passive exploit in his skill tree.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie arrives at the gates of Oakhaven, trying to hide his red name tag.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie successfully enters the town without being arrested.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:8",
              "location_start_label": "Boss Chamber Exit",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Gates",
              "location_start": "LOC_BOSS_EXIT",
              "location_end": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_GATES",
              "handoff_mode": "time_skip",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "The bright sunshine of the world outside the tutorial is blinding.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["sunshine", "tutorial exit", "blinding", "dusty road"],
              "transition_out_text": "He pulls his hood low, hoping the red glow above his head isn't too obvious.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["hood", "red glow", "head", "crowd"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Artie hides in a dark alley to inspect his updated character sheet.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie discovers a new passive skill that rewards his glass-cannon state.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:1",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Gates",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Alley",
              "location_start": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_GATES",
              "location_end": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_ALLEY",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "He ducks behind a stack of empty crates as a patrol of guards passes by.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["crates", "guards", "patrol", "shadows"],
              "transition_out_text": "He swipes his hand through the air, bringing up the skill menu.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["swipe", "skill menu", "blue light", "text"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:3"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie reads the description of 'Hit & Run' and realizes its potential for exploitation.",
              "type": "decision",
              "outcome": "Artie identifies the 'Hit & Run' passive exploit in his skill tree.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:2",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Alley",
              "location_start": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_ALLEY",
              "location_end": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_ALLEY",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The words 'Hit & Run' glow with a faint, glitchy static in the UI.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["Hit & Run", "glitchy static", "UI", "description"],
              "transition_out_text": "A grin spreads across his face as he realizes the System just gave him a license to cheat.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["grin", "System", "cheat", "alleyway"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:4",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie identifies the 'Hit & Run' passive exploit in his skill tree."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Agility Grind",
          "intent": "Artie gathers intel and basic supplies for his glass-cannon build.",
          "end_condition": "Artie locates the dungeon containing the Speedster's Cloak.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Artie visits a shady merchant to look for agility-boosting gear.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie learns about the Speedster's Cloak.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:3",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Alley",
              "location_end_label": "Shady Shop",
              "location_start": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_ALLEY",
              "location_end": "LOC_SHADY_SHOP",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "He slips into a shop that smells of old parchment and unwashed adventurers.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["parchment", "adventurers", "shop", "dim light"],
              "transition_out_text": "The merchant leans in, whispering about a treasure hidden in the catacombs.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["merchant", "whispering", "treasure", "catacombs"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:5"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Artie eavesdrops on a group of high-level players at the local tavern.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie confirms the location of the Snail-Shell Catacombs.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:4",
              "location_start_label": "Shady Shop",
              "location_end_label": "The Rusty Tankard",
              "location_start": "LOC_SHADY_SHOP",
              "location_end": "LOC_RUSTY_TANKARD",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "restricted",
              "transition_in_text": "The roar of the tavern hits him like a physical wave of sound and ale.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["tavern roar", "sound", "ale", "crowd"],
              "transition_out_text": "He catches the name of the dungeon between the boasts of a drunken warrior.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["dungeon name", "warrior", "boasts", "ale mug"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie trades his only valuable item for a map of the catacombs.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie acquires the map to the dungeon.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:5",
              "location_start_label": "The Rusty Tankard",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Market",
              "location_start": "LOC_RUSTY_TANKARD",
              "location_end": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_MARKET",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He meets a hooded figure near the fountain, the map tucked under their arm.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["hooded figure", "fountain", "map", "exchange"],
              "transition_out_text": "He clutches the parchment tightly, his next destination clear.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["parchment", "destination", "market square", "fountain"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:7"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "Artie studies the map and finds the hidden entrance to the catacombs.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie locates the dungeon containing the Speedster's Cloak.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:6",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Market",
              "location_end_label": "Oakhaven Outskirts",
              "location_start": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_MARKET",
              "location_end": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "The town walls fall behind him as he follows the trail into the woods.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["town walls", "trail", "woods", "map"],
              "transition_out_text": "He finds the stone archway buried under a century of ivy and moss.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["stone archway", "ivy", "moss", "entrance"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:8",
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie locates the dungeon containing the Speedster's Cloak."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Catacomb Entry",
          "intent": "Artie commits to the high-level dungeon dive.",
          "end_condition": "Artie enters the Snail-Shell Catacombs, locking the entrance behind him.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie prepares his meager inventory for the dive, realizing he has no room for error.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts that his 1 HP means any mistake is final.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:7",
              "location_start_label": "Oakhaven Outskirts",
              "location_end_label": "Snail-Shell Entrance",
              "location_start": "LOC_OAKHAVEN_OUTSKIRTS",
              "location_end": "LOC_SNAIL_SHELL_ENTRANCE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He sits on a fallen log, checking his boots and his single dagger.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["fallen log", "boots", "dagger", "inventory"],
              "transition_out_text": "He stands up, looking at the dark maw of the dungeon entrance.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["dark maw", "dungeon entrance", "shadows", "determination"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:9"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 9,
              "summary": "Artie approaches the entrance and feels the aura of the high-level zone.",
              "type": "development",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the dungeon's influence zone.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:8",
              "location_start_label": "Snail-Shell Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Snail-Shell Entrance",
              "location_start": "LOC_SNAIL_SHELL_ENTRANCE",
              "location_end": "LOC_SNAIL_SHELL_ENTRANCE",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "A chill wind blows from the depths, carrying the scent of damp earth.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["chill wind", "depths", "damp earth", "stone"],
              "transition_out_text": "He takes a deep breath and steps across the threshold.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["deep breath", "threshold", "darkness", "stone"],
              "hands_off_to": "2:10"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 10,
              "summary": "Artie seals the entrance to prevent anyone from following him in.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Artie enters the Snail-Shell Catacombs, locking the entrance behind him.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "2:9",
              "location_start_label": "Snail-Shell Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Snail-Shell Interior",
              "location_start": "LOC_SNAIL_SHELL_ENTRANCE",
              "location_end": "LOC_SNAIL_SHELL_INTERIOR",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "He pulls the heavy iron lever, and the stone door slides shut with a boom.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["iron lever", "stone door", "boom", "sealed"],
              "end_condition_echo": "Artie enters the Snail-Shell Catacombs, locking the entrance behind him."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
